text:
The 1960 deed gave the friend a fee simple subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25. That executory interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, because church use and a child’s turning 25 might occur more than 21 years after every life in being at the conveyance. Striking it leaves title in the friend in fee simple absolute, and the sister’s later children take nothing.

CONFIDENCE: 90
